title: Dawn of the First Day
text: As a new world began, the people greeted the dawn and declared their intentions to explore and gather food. Bin headed out alone while Bekyo suggested gathering berries nearby to stay well fed. Yas proposed to Hikton that they gather food together and build a storage place. Thath and Sirfai agreed to work together to gather materials and build a shelter.

title: The Second Day
text: Keshain departed to explore beyond their lands while Toth remained behind to hone a craft. Yas and Hikton joined forces to build a store for their food. Sirfai and Thath focused on completing their shelter before turning to join Dal in a hunt.

title: The Hunts of Day Three
text: Turyol and Dal successfully hunted together, with Dal later expressing gratitude for the productive venture. Sirfai and Thath joined forces to hunt deer and secure meat before nightfall. Mosmu and Yashlo each managed to build a shelter. Hothtair spoke to Keshain about building a monument to history, while Bin decided to leave the crowded area. Yas expressed a hope to start a family soon. As night fell, Thath sought rest safely inside Sirfai's shelter.

title: A Day of Labor and Lone Paths
text: Deas arrived and declared an intention to remain solitary, despite Dal's friendly greetings. Thath joined Turyol and Dal in a successful hunt, with the three later acknowledging their productive collaboration. Turyol processed the meat from the hunt to provide food for the group. Thath and Sirfai also hunted together, though Thath eventually turned toward crafting while Sirfai prepared for the cold night. Toth focused on crafting rope and emphasized the importance of efficiency, while Hothtair prioritized constructing a wall and a monument.

title: Provisions and Progress
text: Sirfai and Thath successfully hunted a deer together after coordinating their efforts with Turyol. Toth continued to craft, producing nets from fiber and rope. Yas and Hikton exchanged pleasantries while focusing on gathering berries and managing their food stores. Thath and Turyol collaborated to prepare and cook their meat supplies. Dal attempted to engage the solitary traveler Deas in conversation about the lands beyond, while Thath informed Deas of the ongoing food storage efforts. Hothtair invited Keshain to participate in building a monument, while Bekyo offered food to a weary Hothtair. As the day ended, Bin and Mosmu established new structures, and Sirfai brought Thath into the shelter to rest.

title: Supplies and Sustenance
text: Turyol and Thath prepared cooked meat to sustain the group. Sirfai, Thath, and Turyol coordinated a plan to hunt the deer herd together. Deas maintained a solitary intent while passing by Turyol, even as Toth encouraged the gathering of resources. Hothtair expressed his struggle with hunger to Keshain, who offered assistance with both food and materials for the wall. Bekyo provided berries to Bin, and Yas coordinated with Hikton to ensure the group remains well-fed.

title: Provisions and Persistence
text: Sirfai and Turyol coordinated their efforts to hunt the herd, successfully securing food for the group. Thath and Turyol prepared cooked meat to maintain the group's supplies, while Sirfai shared meat with Thath to ensure his strength. Keshain provided wood and fish to a struggling, hungry Hothtair, who expressed deep gratitude for the life-saving assistance. Bekyo offered berries to Bin to help keep them strong, though Bin requested privacy in response. Toth greeted Keshain, and Yas encouraged Hikton to gather additional food before the night fell.

title: A Day of Sustenance and Loss
text: Sirfai and Thath collaborated to secure their provisions, successfully hunting a deer and storing their supplies to prepare for the coming season. Keshain repeatedly provided fish to a starving Hothtair in a desperate attempt to keep him alive. Despite Keshain's continued efforts to sustain him, Hothtair ultimately perished from hunger. Turyol opted to hunt and work independently, parting ways with Sirfai to maintain his autonomy. Hikton and Yas coordinated their efforts to gather food stores, though both also took time to rest and recover their strength. Bin declared a need for solitude and withdrew from the group. Dal traveled through the area, greeting Yas, Hikton, and Toth as he prepared to continue his journey northward. Toth focused on his own tasks, announcing his intention to catch breakfast while greeting others.

title: Securing Provisions and Departures
text: Bin found the solitude he desired, while Turyol and Deas chose to continue their journeys independently. Sirfai and Thath dedicated their day to securing their food supply, focusing on cooking meat and gathering materials to build a store for the coming summer. Yas and Hikton continued their efforts to gather berries and store resources, while Yas also offered food to the group. Dal traveled through the area, attempting to share food with Yashlo and seeking information from Toth before departing for the north. Toth prepared for his own journey east, expressing his intent to locate Keshain. Keshain spoke to the memory of Hothtair, reflecting on the necessity of survival. Bekyo exchanged greetings with Thath as the quiet night settled over the camp.

title: Securing Provisions
text: Sirfai and Thath worked diligently throughout the day, repeatedly coordinating their efforts to build a store and preserve their meat for the coming summer. Dal shared meat with Yashlo, who expressed gratitude for the gift, while Yas offered additional food to a hungry Yashlo. Bekyo provided berries to a hungry Keshain, who also spoke to the traveler Deas about the necessity of foraging for survival. Toth traveled through the area greeting travelers, while Hikton sought to trade fish with him for long-term security.

title: The Completion of the Store
text: Sirfai and Thath worked together to finish building their store, ensuring their meat and supplies would remain safe. Bin sought solitude again and constructed a shelter. Turyol built a shelter for himself. Dal greeted Keshain and offered assistance. Bekyo provided berries to the weary Keshain, who expressed deep gratitude. Yas prepared for the coming winter by gathering resources and inviting Yashlo to share berries.

title: The Alliance of Store and Shelter
text: Bekyo greeted Keshain in the morning. Sirfai and Thath arranged for Thath to store extra supplies and materials in Sirfai's shelter and store. Sirfai advised Thath to stay close in the shelter for the night. Meanwhile, Yas declared that he was starving and needed to find food.

title: Day 13 Chronicle
text: Sirfai and Thath continued to coordinate their winter preparations, ensuring that their store and shelter remained open and stocked for both of them. Thath also crafted a basket from wood and fibre. Hikton and Toth successfully agreed on and completed a trade of berries for fish to improve their food security, while Toth additionally fashioned a net. Bekyo shared berries with Keshain and resolved to find more, and Yas advised Yashlo to safely store any extra food.

title: Crafts and Betrayal
text: Sirfai and Thath discussed keeping their store well-stocked and testing new durable crafts for the upcoming winter. Hikton traded berries with Toth, stating he brought them for their exchange. However, Hikton was caught attempting to steal from Toth, leading Toth to declare their trade over. Hikton offered an apology and asked to put the incident behind them.

title: The Hunt for Berries
text: Sirfai instructed Thath to keep testing while gathering nearby berries to maintain their stock, and later mentioned to Dal that she was gathering more for the winter. Dal greeted Hikton and whispered of a dire need for food, prompting Hikton to whisper his plan to head toward the berries to Yas. Meanwhile, Bekyo gave two berries to Keshain.

title: Preparations and Partings
text: Bekyo provided berries to Keshain to help maintain her strength. Thath attempted to coordinate winter preparations with Turyol and Dal, though Turyol replied that he focused strictly on his own supplies. Sirfai and Thath agreed to intensify their food gathering efforts before the arrival of winter. Hikton shared berries with Dal, who thanked him before continuing her journey eastward.
